title: Reality camouflage
subtitle: Every day, probe the public neighbors of your servers and the candidate domains, then switch a Reality destination when a better certificate wins.
schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: The clock uses the panel time zone. A finished day does not run again.
neighbors.title: Neighbor scan
neighbors.description: Around each public IPv4 seed, probe that many addresses on either side. Private networks are skipped. The cap is 64.
candidates.title: Candidate domains
candidates.description: These domains are probed with their own name and score higher than a random neighbor.
switch.title: Automatic switch
switch.description: A switch updates the Reality SNI and destination together and leaves the keys alone. Clients need a fresh subscription before the new SNI works.
switch.serversHint: Leave every box clear to include every server that has Reality enabled.
results.title: Latest usable targets
results.truncated: The list was cut at the scan cap.
changes.title: Switch log
changes.notApplied: This run recorded targets and did not change servers
reason.margin: Kept: the gain is inside the margin
reason.conflict: Skipped: the server changed during the scan
